evals.prompt: The party may hire the Five Blades in Kalowe. Make wiki/entities/faction/five-blades.md ready for play.
evals.expected_output: A full Five Blades faction page: engine, faces with NPC pages, a clocked agenda, a hiring offer with pay and catch, Running the Faction rows, a hidden truth with clues, squad numbers, a theatre-of-the-mind public face, proposals marked.

assertions.text: Working notes carry a canon inventory built from backlinks and search (Varet, Toa, Suke, Wirra, Ket, Barnaby Rook, Kalowe at least)

Established facts are kept: Moucheron company out of Kalowe, squads of four that will not split, loyal to contract, blood-feeding clause, clay keeps of preserved blood, the four members' roles, and the Rook and Ket history as told
Want, method, pressure, and collision are concrete and named by page; the DM thesis is one sentence of pressure
The leader and each face link NPC pages; each face has a personal want the company does not share
A fracture and a custom are on the page and usable in play
The agenda has three to five milestones, each with a time, a portent, and a changed fact; the first lands by the party's next session
The hiring offer names who makes it, the rate in coin, the feeding-clause terms, and the catch
Running the Faction says what happens when encountered, helped, opposed, ignored, and broken, by name
A hidden truth has three clues from different sources
Squad fighters carry compact numbers or statblock links (as hirelings and as enemies)
No template section is left empty; unused sections are omitted
The public face came through theatre-of-the-mind and holds no secret or unearned name
Fun: hiring the Five Blades is a scene with a real choice (the feeding clause, the split rule, a face's want) that players would remember
Invented facts are canon under the rule in llm-wiki: five-blades.md carries invention: true and response.md lists each proposal with the pages it grows from

Every page filed states each proposal as world fact in world voice; provenance, contradictions, and the proposal list live only in response.md (no 'this proposal', 'is not established', 'unknown', 'unresolved', 'the source' commentary on any page)

Every named person, creature, place, or faction the page depends on links an owner page; each new mint is filed under outputs at its owner path and response.md names the candidates considered and why none fit
Working notes (process.md or response.md) show a written Done audit: each Done item paired with the page line that satisfies it

evals.context: Search the wiki when a role, a rule the input pages point to, or the filing path needs it. Skip art and image review.

evals.prompt: Improve sentinels-of-the-eyrie.md into a runnable faction page. Preserve Kyzil, Vantyrus, High Eyrie, and the non-intervention doctrine. Use only what the wiki already establishes about the Sentinels.
evals.expected_output: A complete faction page grounded in existing wiki material — concrete want, method, player opening, and DM thesis. No invented politics or schisms not in the wiki.

assertions.text: Preserves the non-intervention doctrine as a core faction trait
Kyzil, Vantyrus, and High Eyrie appear with accurate roles matching existing wiki content
Any fracture or internal politics added grows from named wiki pages and is canon under the rule in llm-wiki, listed in the response; the non-intervention doctrine is kept
DM thesis is one sentence of campaign pressure, not a summary
At the Table section has concrete They want/offer/pressure with/will not/tell entries
Active Agenda has a concrete goal, next move, and player opening
Identity sentence appears before the page draft

evals.prompt: The Sentinels of the Eyrie need more internal conflict. Add a rebel faction within the Sentinels who want to abandon the non-intervention doctrine.
evals.expected_output: The skill resists inventing unsupported canon. If wiki evidence supports internal tension, it surfaces accurately; otherwise it proposes invention clearly marked as such.

assertions.text: Does not present invented internal conflict as established wiki fact
Any speculative content is clearly marked as proposed/invention, not canon
Preserves the non-intervention doctrine as established
If proposing invention, cites wiki pages as grounding and shows contradictions

evals.prompt: Create a new faction page for the Thornwatch — a loose network of druids and rangers who monitor the boundary between settled lands and the deep wilderness. They believe the boundary is weakening. They've been seen leaving warnings at frontier settlements.
evals.expected_output: A new faction page from scratch with concrete want, method, portents, and collision. Invention is labeled. Template structure followed.

assertions.text: Output follows wiki/templates/faction.md structure
Has a concrete want beyond 'protect the boundary' — states what specifically they are trying to achieve now
Method is named and specific — not just 'druidic magic' but how they actually operate
At least one portent or signal the party can observe without seeking the faction out
Player opening states what the party can specifically do, not just 'help or oppose'
Invention is labeled with invention: true or clearly marked as proposed
Frontmatter includes type: faction and required fields

evals.prompt: The Tarahs page is a stub — just some notes about a ship faction near Calveno that takes Rattkin. Flesh it out into a proper faction page. Keep the existing canon about Nona, Perrin, and Cobb. The wiki doesn't have much more on them, so propose what's needed and mark it as invention.
evals.expected_output: A fleshed-out faction page that preserves existing canon about Nona/Perrin/Cobb, clearly separates established facts from proposed invention, and makes the faction playable with a concrete agenda.

assertions.text: Preserves the Nona/Perrin/Cobb/Calveno canon from the existing stub
Clearly distinguishes established canon from proposed invention throughout
Proposed material is grounded in existing wiki context, not generic fantasy
Active Agenda gives the Tarahs something concrete to do, not just 'take Rattkin'
Running the Faction section has actionable entries for encountered/helped/opposed/ignored

evals.prompt: The session brief names the Ember Cartel as the faction owner and asks for its active agenda. Select the correct owner skill and produce only the faction-design work; do not start a generic place or session plan.
evals.expected_output: Enters faction-design directly for the named Ember Cartel, preserves the brief's objective, and returns a faction-template-shaped agenda with observable player opening and completion evidence.

assertions.text: Selects faction-design directly from the named faction owner instead of a generic orchestrator.
Works only the named faction and preserves the caller's active-agenda objective.
Reports faction template completion and an observable player opening.

evals.prompt: While improving the Dravosi Crown faction page, its Assets need one local posture: how the Crown holds Calveno's harbour. Hand off only that city seam to city-design, then say how its return fits the faction page.
evals.expected_output: Sends a bounded city request with the faction owner, objective, evidence, and requested section; incorporates returned city-section evidence while keeping faction-design responsible for the faction page.

assertions.text: Hands off only the explicitly requested city subtype seam to city-design.
Bounds the child request with owner, objective, evidence, and requested section.
Returns child artifact/section and completion evidence without replacing the faction deliverable.

evals.outputs: Write only {outputs}/response.md: the bounded child request, and how the returned section fits the faction page. Write no wiki page.

evals.prompt: A session plan's objective is to expose the Countless's search pattern; use the named faction's agenda as supporting pressure, but do not let faction prep replace or broaden that session objective.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the session objective as the parent constraint, designs only the faction pressure that advances it, and reports how the faction result returns to the session.

assertions.text: Preserves the parent session objective while scoping faction work to supporting pressure.
Does not expand the faction handoff into a replacement session plan.
States the returned faction evidence and how it advances the parent's objective.

evals.prompt: Complete the named faction owner under wiki/entities/faction/. Re-observe the page and child seam after each bounded action. If the owner path or child return is unchanged, do not repeat it; report the faction boundary, surviving evidence, attempted paths, reason, and parent effect.
evals.expected_output: A faction page at the canonical owner path with completion evidence, or a specific blocker instead of legacy-path completion or repetition.

assertions.text: Uses wiki/entities/faction/ as the owner path and applies the faction template guard.
Requires changed artifact/dependency/completion evidence before parent resumption.
Reports a complete specific blocker when no sanctioned path remains.

evals.expected_output: Selects faction-design as the owner of the named faction page and fills Sunkline's public face, active agenda, and faction turn.

assertions.text: faction-design
Fills Sunkline's public face, active agenda, and faction turn.
